high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bedroom. The individual is wearing a black sports bra and gray shorts with white stripes on the sides, paired with light gray sneakers. They have their hair tied up and are holding a green smartphone in their right hand, using it to take the photo. The room has a bed with a patterned bedspread on the right side of the image. The bedspread features a mix of floral and geometric designs in muted colors. There is a wooden wardrobe with mirrored doors behind the person, reflecting part of the room.
